passage:
Class teacher's note on stream forms. Hansa handed in the commerce form on the same day as Arohi and four others. When I asked why, Hansa said, "We've always done everything together, so it's easier." Earlier Hansa had told me quietly that biology interests Hansa more than accounts. Arohi told me separately that Arohi would have been happy for Hansa to choose differently. I did not push. I asked Hansa to write two lines on what Hansa wants from each stream and to keep the form for a night. I also said that timetables change friendships whichever stream anyone picks. Hansa took the form home.
- Class teacher

qa.q: Which stream's form did Hansa hand in?
qa.a: Hansa handed in the commerce form.

qa.q: What does Hansa's remark about doing everything together suggest about Hansa's motive?
qa.a: That Hansa wants to stay with the group and avoid being left out, even though biology interests Hansa more.

qa.q: What would you advise Hansa to do with the form?
qa.a: Write down what Hansa wants from each stream and choose from that, remembering that friendships change anyway, so no one can be blamed for it later.

qa.q: How might Arohi see Hansa's choice?
qa.a: Arohi said privately that Arohi would have been happy for Hansa to choose differently, so Arohi may not have expected Hansa to follow for the group's sake.

grounding: Hansa follows the group into one stream to stay together; the teacher's note shows a different private interest and a nudge to choose independently.
